imgguard-rejected: Shown to the uploader when a file is rejected by ImgGuard.
imgguard-busy: Shown to the uploader when ImgGuard was unable to screen the file because it was already at capacity.
logentry-imgguard-reject:
{{doc-logentry|imgguard|reject}}

Parameters:
* $1 - the performer (with tool links)
* $2 - the performer's plain username
* $3 - the uploaded file's page
* $6 - SFW score, the number compared against ImgGuardSfwThreshold
logentry-imgguard-monitor:
{{doc-logentry|imgguard|monitor}}

Parameters:
* $1 - the performer (with tool links)
* $2 - the performer's plain username
* $3 - the uploaded file's page
* $6 - SFW score, the number compared against ImgGuardSfwThreshold
logentry-imgguard-fail:
{{doc-logentry|imgguard|fail}}

Parameters:
* $1 - the performer (with tool links)
* $2 - the performer's plain username
* $3 - the uploaded file's page
* $15 - short code for why screening did not complete
logentry-imgguard-pass:
{{doc-logentry|imgguard|pass}}

Parameters:
* $1 - the performer (with tool links)
* $2 - the performer's plain username
* $3 - the uploaded file's page
* $6 - SFW score, the number compared against ImgGuardSfwThreshold
logentry-imgguard-borderline:
{{doc-logentry|imgguard|borderline}} Logged for an upload that passed but scored within ImgGuardBorderlineMargin of the threshold.

Parameters:
* $1 - the performer (with tool links)
* $2 - the performer's plain username
* $3 - the uploaded file's page
* $6 - SFW score, the number compared against ImgGuardSfwThreshold
logentry-imgguard-autoblock:
{{doc-logentry|imgguard|autoblock}} Logged when the ImgGuard system user automatically blocks a user.

Parameters:
* $1 - the performer (the ImgGuard system user, with tool links)
* $2 - the performer's plain username
* $3 - the blocked user's page
* $4 - block duration
* $5 - number of prior rejections that triggered the block
imgguard-autoblock-reason: Block reason used for ImgGuard's automatic block, shown in Special:BlockList and Special:Log/block.
